periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation slanting downward and inward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly elongated oval with a vertical major axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the center of the patch mass located below the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Relatively thick, covering the entire shoulder region and descending approximately 30% of the visible torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between ears is approximately equal to the cranial width between the inner ear bases.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex curvature at the ear tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish/pink linear mark or skin irritation present on the mid-ventral chest area.
other_distinctive_markers: Light-colored wood shavings and debris adhering to the dark and white fur of the chest and limbs.
